changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_note_snippet_live ON note (snippet_id) WHERE snippet_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL;

INSERT INTO note (sentence_id, manuscript_id, scratchpad_id, user_id, color, body, priority, flagged, position, snippet_id) SELECT NULL, COALESCE(s.linked_manuscript_id, sp.linked_manuscript_id), NULL, s.user_id, 'yellow', NULL, 'none', false, 'a0', s.snippet_id FROM snippet s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sk.scratchpad_id FROM sketch sk WHERE sk.snippet_id = s.snippet_id AND sk.scratchpad_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sk.sketch_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) home ON true LEFT JOIN scratchpad sp ON sp.scratchpad_id = home.scratchpad_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM note n WHERE n.snippet_id = s.snippet_id AND n.deleted_at IS NULL );
